panels._comment: Rear panel. The shell's rear rim sits at x=-0.376 with side walls outboard of |z|=0.235 and a top rail below y=0.11; the plate fills that opening flush with the back of the body.

panels._comment: Floor pan. Outline traces the shell's footprint (wide at the rear, tapering to the front) and stops at x=0.145, clear of the weapon bar which starts at x=0.155. Sits at the height of the rear skirts' bottom edge so the chassis rests on it.
